dz: 阿基泰纳的威廉一世赠予了伯诺一世(abbot Berno)一行靠近马康的一行地,以找到新的修道院. 与其他本笃会修道院相反,威廉将修道院置于任何封建领主的控制之外.
de: William I of Aquitaine gifts abbot Berno a group of lands close to Mâcon to found a new monastery. Contrary to other Benedictine monasteries, William sets the monastery outside of the control of any feudal lord.
